build_transformer_model: build a BaseTransformer model with specified dim, n_layers, and attention head configuration
create_attention_layer: create an Attention module with GQA support using n_heads and n_kv_heads parameters
apply_rotary_embedding: apply rotary positional embeddings to query and key tensors using apply_rotary_emb
generate_document_mask: generate a document-aware attention mask mod for sequence-stacked inputs using generate_doc_mask_mod
initialize_feedforward_network: initialize a SiLU-gated FeedForward network with configurable hidden dimension and multiple_of constraint
